items.problem: AGENTS.md `## repo` says the failure of a game outside the harness core names two ways out (`ogw core upgrade`, or the harness at the tag `core-v<core version of the game>`), and `skills/game-loop/SKILL.md:54` has the lead agent report those two, but for a game on a newer core `requireHarnessCore` passes `upgradable` null, so `remedy` names only the harness tag (`requireSupportedCore` at line 45 to 46 does the same). Reproduced by `tools/test/commands/loop/start.test.ts:351-353`, which asserts that one-way text for game core 1.0.0 on harness tag `core-v0.9.0`. An upgrade cannot lower a core, so the direction is likely to narrow the sentence of AGENTS.md to a game on an older core rather than to change the code
